propDescs.AnimatedContent.distance: Distance (in pixels) the component moves during animation.
propDescs.AnimatedContent.reverse: Whether the animation moves in the reverse direction.
propDescs.AnimatedContent.duration: Duration of the animation in seconds.
propDescs.AnimatedContent.ease: GSAP easing function for the animation.
propDescs.AnimatedContent.animateOpacity: Whether to animate opacity during transition.
propDescs.Antigravity.waveAmplitude: Intensity of the wave (0 for perfect circle)
propDescs.Antigravity.lerpSpeed: How fast particles move to the ring
propDescs.Antigravity.particleShape: Shape of the particles (capsule, sphere, box, tetrahedron)
propDescs.BlobCursor.sizes: Sizes (px) of each blob. Length must be ≥ trailCount.
propDescs.BlobCursor.innerSizes: Sizes (px) of inner dots. Length must be ≥ trailCount.
propDescs.BlobCursor.innerColor: Background color of the inner dot.
propDescs.BlobCursor.opacities: Opacity of each blob. Length ≥ trailCount.
propDescs.BlobCursor.filterId: Optional custom filter ID (for multiple instances).
propDescs.BlobCursor.fastDuration: GSAP duration for the lead blob.
propDescs.BlobCursor.slowDuration: GSAP duration for the following blobs.
propDescs.BlobCursor.fastEase: GSAP ease for the lead blob.
propDescs.BlobCursor.slowEase: GSAP ease for the following blobs.
propDescs.BlobCursor.zIndex: CSS z-index of the whole component.
propDescs.ClickSpark.sparkRadius: Distance sparks travel from the click center.
propDescs.ClickSpark.sparkCount: Number of spark lines per click.
propDescs.ClickSpark.extraScale: Scale multiplier for spark distance and size.
propDescs.Crosshair.containerRef: Optional container ref to limit crosshair to specific element. If null, crosshair will be active on entire viewport.
propDescs.Cubes.gridSize: The size of the grid (number of cubes per row/column)
propDescs.Cubes.cubeSize: Fixed size of each cube in pixels. If not provided, cubes will be responsive
propDescs.Cubes.maxAngle: Maximum rotation angle for the tilt effect in degrees
propDescs.Cubes.radius: Radius of the tilt effect (how many cubes around the cursor are affected)
propDescs.Cubes.easing: GSAP easing function for the tilt animation
propDescs.Cubes.duration: Animation duration for enter and leave effects
propDescs.Cubes.cellGap: Gap between cubes. Can be a number or object with row/col properties
propDescs.Cubes.borderStyle: CSS border style for cube faces
propDescs.Cubes.shadow: Shadow effect for cubes. Can be boolean or custom CSS shadow
propDescs.Cubes.autoAnimate: Whether to automatically animate when user is idle
propDescs.Cubes.rippleOnClick: Whether to show ripple effect on click
propDescs.Cubes.rippleSpeed: Speed multiplier for the ripple animation
propDescs.ElectricBorder.color: Stroke/glow color. Any CSS color (hex, rgb, hsl).
propDescs.ElectricBorder.chaos: Distortion intensity (0 = no distortion, higher = more chaotic).
propDescs.ElectricBorder.borderRadius: Border radius in pixels for the electric border path.
propDescs.ElectricBorder.className: Optional className applied to the root wrapper.
propDescs.ElectricBorder.children: Content rendered inside the bordered container.
propDescs.FadeContent.blur: Whether to also animate a 10px blur on entrance.
propDescs.FadeContent.duration: Animation duration; values >10 are treated as ms, otherwise seconds.
propDescs.FadeContent.delay: Delay before animation starts; values >10 treated as ms.
propDescs.FadeContent.disappearAfter: If >0, fades back out after this duration once entrance completes.
propDescs.FadeContent.disappearEase: GSAP easing for the disappear tween.
propDescs.FadeContent.onComplete: Fires when the entrance animation completes.
propDescs.FadeContent.onDisappearanceComplete: Fires when the optional disappear animation completes.
propDescs.FadeContent.container: Optional scroller (selector or element) for ScrollTrigger.
propDescs.GhostCursor.className: Additional CSS class names for the container.
propDescs.GhostCursor.style: Inline styles for the container element.
propDescs.GhostCursor.trailLength: Number of points stored for the cursor trail (longer = longer smear).
propDescs.GhostCursor.inertia: Velocity retention when the pointer stops. Higher values make the cursor glide longer.
propDescs.GhostCursor.grainIntensity: Strength of the film grain post-processing pass.
propDescs.GhostCursor.bloomRadius: UnrealBloom radius controlling spread of glow.
propDescs.GhostCursor.bloomThreshold: UnrealBloom threshold; lower includes more pixels in bloom.
propDescs.GhostCursor.brightness: Final brightness multiplier applied to the effect color.
propDescs.GhostCursor.color: Base color of the ghost cursor effect.
propDescs.GhostCursor.mixBlendMode: Blend mode used when compositing with page content.
propDescs.GhostCursor.edgeIntensity: Darkening near edges of the canvas. 0 = none, 1 = strongest.
propDescs.GhostCursor.maxDevicePixelRatio: Upper cap for devicePixelRatio to control render cost on high-DPR displays.
propDescs.GhostCursor.targetPixels: Pixel budget. Resolution is dynamically scaled to keep total pixel count under this budget.
propDescs.GhostCursor.fadeDelayMs: Idle delay before the trail starts to fade after pointer leaves/stops.
propDescs.GhostCursor.fadeDurationMs: Duration of the trail fade-out once the delay has elapsed.
propDescs.GhostCursor.zIndex: z-index applied to the canvas for layering above/below content.
propDescs.GlareHover.width: The width of the hover element.
propDescs.GlareHover.height: The height of the hover element.
propDescs.GlareHover.background: The background color of the element.
propDescs.GlareHover.borderRadius: The border radius of the element.
propDescs.GlareHover.borderColor: The border color of the element.
propDescs.GlareHover.glareColor: The color of the glare effect (hex format).
propDescs.GlareHover.glareOpacity: The opacity of the glare effect (0-1).
propDescs.GlareHover.glareAngle: The angle of the glare effect in degrees.
propDescs.GlareHover.glareSize: The size of the glare effect as a percentage (e.g. 250 = 250%).
propDescs.GlareHover.transitionDuration: The duration of the transition in milliseconds.
propDescs.GradualBlur.position: Edge to attach the blur overlay.
propDescs.GradualBlur.strength: Base blur strength multiplier (affects each layer).
propDescs.GradualBlur.width: Custom width (optional). Defaults to 100% for vertical positions or matches height for horizontal positions.
propDescs.GradualBlur.divCount: Number of stacked blur layers (higher = smoother gradient).
propDescs.GradualBlur.exponential: Use exponential progression for stronger end blur.
propDescs.GradualBlur.curve: Distribution curve applied to layer progression.
propDescs.GradualBlur.opacity: Opacity applied to each blur layer.
propDescs.GradualBlur.animated: Fade in (true) or reveal on scroll ("scroll").
propDescs.GradualBlur.hoverIntensity: Multiplier applied to strength while hovered.
propDescs.GradualBlur.target: Position relative to parent container or the entire page (fixed).
propDescs.GradualBlur.onAnimationComplete: Callback fired after animated reveal completes.
propDescs.GradualBlur.className: Additional class names appended to root element.
propDescs.GradualBlur.style: Inline style overrides merged into container style.
propDescs.ImageTrail.items: An array of image URLs which will be animated in the trail.
propDescs.ImageTrail.variant: A number from 1 to 8 - all different animation styles.
propDescs.LaserFlow.horizontalBeamOffset: Horizontal offset of the beam (0-1 of canvas width).
propDescs.LaserFlow.verticalBeamOffset: Vertical offset of the beam (0-1 of canvas height).
propDescs.LaserFlow.horizontalSizing: Horizontal sizing factor of the beam footprint.
propDescs.LaserFlow.verticalSizing: Vertical sizing factor of the beam footprint.
propDescs.LaserFlow.flowSpeed: Speed of the beam’s flow modulation.
propDescs.LaserFlow.flowStrength: Strength of the beam’s flow modulation.
propDescs.LaserFlow.fogScale: Spatial scale for the fog noise.
propDescs.LaserFlow.fogFallSpeed: Drift speed for the fog field.
propDescs.LaserFlow.mouseTiltStrength: How much mouse x tilts the fog volume.
propDescs.LaserFlow.decay: Beam decay shaping for sampling envelope.
propDescs.LaserFlow.falloffStart: Falloff start radius used in inverse-square blending.
propDescs.LaserFlow.dpr: Device pixel ratio override (defaults to window.devicePixelRatio).
propDescs.LogoLoop.logos: Array of logo items to display. Each item can be either a React node or an image src.
propDescs.LogoLoop.speed: Animation speed in pixels per second. Positive values move based on direction, negative values reverse direction.
propDescs.LogoLoop.direction: Direction of the logo animation loop. Supports horizontal (left/right) and vertical (up/down) scrolling.
propDescs.LogoLoop.width: Width of the logo loop container.
propDescs.LogoLoop.logoHeight: Height of the logos in pixels.
propDescs.LogoLoop.hoverSpeed: Speed when hovering over the component. Set to 0 to pause, or a lower value for deceleration effect.
propDescs.LogoLoop.fadeOut: Whether to apply fade-out effect at the edges of the container.
propDescs.LogoLoop.fadeOutColor: Color used for the fade-out effect. Only applies when fadeOut is true.
propDescs.LogoLoop.scaleOnHover: Whether to scale logos on hover.
propDescs.LogoLoop.renderItem: Custom render function for each logo item. Allows full control over item rendering for animations, tooltips, etc.
propDescs.LogoLoop.ariaLabel: Accessibility label for the logo loop component.
propDescs.LogoLoop.className: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.
propDescs.LogoLoop.style: Inline styles to apply to the root element.
propDescs.MagicRings.colorTwo: Second color — rings interpolate from color to colorTwo.
propDescs.MagicRings.ringCount: Number of concentric rings to draw (1-10).
propDescs.MagicRings.attenuation: Glow falloff — higher values produce tighter glow.
propDescs.MagicRings.scaleRate: How much rings expand over time.
propDescs.MagicRings.blur: CSS blur in px — creates a bloom/glow effect.
propDescs.MagicRings.rotation: Static rotation of the pattern in degrees.
propDescs.MagicRings.ringGap: Exponential base for angular cutaway per ring.
propDescs.MagicRings.fadeIn: Duration of ring fade-in within cycle.
propDescs.MagicRings.fadeOut: Start time of ring fade-out within cycle.
propDescs.MagicRings.followMouse: Rings shift toward the mouse cursor.
propDescs.MagicRings.mouseInfluence: Strength of mouse follow (when followMouse is true).
propDescs.MagicRings.parallax: Per-ring depth offset based on mouse position.
propDescs.MagicRings.clickBurst: Click triggers a brightness flash and scale pulse.
propDescs.Magnet.padding: Specifies the distance (in pixels) around the element that activates the magnet pull.
propDescs.Magnet.disabled: Disables the magnet effect when set to true.
propDescs.Magnet.magnetStrength: Controls the strength of the pull; higher values reduce movement, lower values increase it.
propDescs.Magnet.activeTransition: CSS transition applied to the element when the magnet is active.
propDescs.Magnet.inactiveTransition: CSS transition applied when the magnet is inactive (mouse out of range).
propDescs.Magnet.wrapperClassName: Optional CSS class name for the outermost wrapper element.
propDescs.Magnet.innerClassName: Optional CSS class name for the moving (inner) element.
propDescs.MagnetLines.containerSize: Specifies the width and height of the entire grid container.
propDescs.MagnetLines.lineWidth: Initial rotation angle (in degrees) before pointer movement.
propDescs.MagnetLines.className: Additional class name(s) applied to the container.
propDescs.MetaBalls.color: The base color of the metaballs.
propDescs.MetaBalls.enableMouseInteraction: Enables or disables the ball following the mouse.
propDescs.MetaBalls.enableTransparency: Enables or disables transparency for the container of the animation.
propDescs.MetaBalls.hoverSmoothness: Smoothness factor for the cursor ball when following the mouse.
propDescs.MetaBalls.animationSize: The size of the world for the animation.
propDescs.MetaBalls.clumpFactor: Determines how close together the balls are rendered.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.imageSrc: URL or path to the image used for the metallic paint effect. The image is processed internally.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.seed: Random seed for pattern generation. Different values create different pattern variations.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.scale: Scale of the metallic pattern. Higher values create more repetitions.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.refraction: Amount of chromatic aberration (color separation). Creates the rainbow edge effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.blur: Blur amount for the pattern transitions. Higher values create softer gradients.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.liquid: Amount of liquid/wavy animation applied to the pattern.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.speed: Animation speed multiplier. Set to 0 to disable animation.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.brightness: Overall brightness of the metallic effect. Values above 1 increase brightness.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.contrast: Color contrast of the effect. Higher values create more distinct light/dark areas.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.angle: Rotation angle of the pattern in degrees.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.fresnel: Fresnel effect intensity. Controls edge highlighting based on viewing angle.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.lightColor: Hex color for the bright/highlight areas of the metallic effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.darkColor: Hex color for the dark/shadow areas of the metallic effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.patternSharpness: Controls the sharpness of metallic band transitions. Higher = sharper edges.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.waveAmplitude: Intensity of the wave distortion effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.noiseScale: Scale of the noise pattern. Higher = more detailed noise.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.chromaticSpread: Multiplier for chromatic aberration spread between RGB channels.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.mouseAnimation: When true, mouse position controls wave animation instead of auto-loop.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.distortion: Amount of noise-based distortion applied to the pattern flow (0-1).
propDescs.MetallicPaint.contour: Intensity of edge contour effect that warps the pattern along shape boundaries (0-1).
propDescs.MetallicPaint.tintColor: Hex color for color burn tint effect. White = no tint.
propDescs.Noise.patternSize: Defines the size of the grain pattern.
propDescs.Noise.patternScaleX: Scaling factor for the X-axis of the grain pattern.
propDescs.Noise.patternScaleY: Scaling factor for the Y-axis of the grain pattern.
propDescs.Noise.patternRefreshInterval: Number of frames before the grain pattern refreshes.
propDescs.OrbitImages.images: Array of image URLs to orbit along the path.
propDescs.OrbitImages.shape: Preset shape: ellipse, circle, square, rectangle, triangle, star, heart, infinity, wave, or custom.
propDescs.OrbitImages.customPath: Custom SVG path string (used when shape="custom").
propDescs.OrbitImages.baseWidth: Base width for the design coordinate space used for responsive scaling.
propDescs.OrbitImages.radius: Radius for circle, square, triangle, star, heart shapes.
propDescs.OrbitImages.starPoints: Number of points for star shape.
propDescs.OrbitImages.rotation: Rotation angle of the entire orbit path in degrees.
propDescs.OrbitImages.duration: Duration of one complete orbit in seconds.
propDescs.OrbitImages.itemSize: Width/height of each orbiting item in pixels.
propDescs.OrbitImages.fill: Whether to distribute items evenly around the orbit.
propDescs.OrbitImages.className: Additional CSS class for the container.
propDescs.OrbitImages.showPath: Whether to show the orbit path for debugging.
propDescs.OrbitImages.pathColor: Stroke color when showPath is true.
propDescs.OrbitImages.pathWidth: Stroke width when showPath is true.
propDescs.OrbitImages.easing: Animation easing: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut.
propDescs.OrbitImages.centerContent: Custom content rendered at the center of the orbit.
propDescs.OrbitImages.responsive: Enable responsive scaling based on container width.
propDescs.PixelTransition.firstContent: Content to show by default (e.g., an or text).
propDescs.PixelTransition.secondContent: Content revealed upon hover or click.
propDescs.PixelTransition.gridSize: Number of rows/columns in the pixel grid.
propDescs.PixelTransition.pixelColor: Background color used for each pixel block.
propDescs.PixelTransition.animationStepDuration: Length of the pixel reveal/hide in seconds.
propDescs.PixelTransition.aspectRatio: If true, the transition will not revert on mouse leave or subsequent clicks.
propDescs.PixelTransition.className: Optional additional class names for styling.
propDescs.PixelTransition.style: Optional inline styles for the container.
propDescs.Ribbons.colors: An array of color strings to be used for the ribbons.
propDescs.Ribbons.baseSpring: Base spring factor for the physics controlling ribbon motion.
